description: This is a Java source file defining a REST controller for managing driver-related endpoints in the NeuroFleetX backend. It utilizes Spring annotations to handle HTTP requests for retrieving driver information.

classes.name: DriverController
classes.description: REST controller exposing endpoints for driver operations, handles HTTP GET requests for fetching all drivers or a specific driver by ID.

methods.name: getAllDrivers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of all drivers.

methods.name: getDriver
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve data for a specific driver identified by ID.
